Metformin, the most widely prescribed oral antihyperglycemic agent, is established as the first-line therapy for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) owing to its efficacy, affordability, and safety. Increasing evidence indicates that its benefits extend beyond glycemic control, encompassing cardiovascular protection and diabetes prevention in individuals at elevated cardiometabolic risk.
